title: Visawe (Theme 8: Ndege wa porini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tests each word in the same sentence: three synonyms keep the meaning, a related word changes it.
representations: word sets of three with one intruder
steps: Keep those that do not change it.
Use one in a new sentence.

board.say: Ni maneno yapi yanafaa hapa kwa maana ileile?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child chooses "mtoto, mwana" and explains why a third word does not fit.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___." Kwa nini "huzuni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana sawa. Furaha na huzuni ni vinyume, si visawe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "huzuni" ni ___." Kwa nini "kilio" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Neno linalohusiana na jingine si lazima liwe na maana sawa nalo. Kisawe cha huzuni ni simanzi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___." Kwa nini "harufu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.

misconceptions.ask: Ukiweka "mfuko" badala ya "pesa", sentensi ina maana ileile?
misconceptions.repair: Mfuko ni mahali pa kuweka pesa, si jina lingine la pesa.
